name: Custom Etched Glencairn Whisky Glass - Any Name
description: The Glencairn® Personalized 6.25oz Scotch Glass is the official whiskey glass; like a good whiskey, this glass has plenty of character! It is a revolutionary whiskey glass that lets one savor the taste and complexity of fine whiskey, great for single malt whisky, Irish whisky and single barrel bourbons. Tapered mouth provides the ability to smell all of the nuances the whiskey has to offer. Designed by Raymond Davidson 25 years ago, in collaboration with the 5 largest whisky companies asking them to perfect his initial design. Today it can be found at every distillery in Scotland, Ireland, Wales and the USA.
